<style>
        .sr-only {
            position: fixed;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            width: 1px;
            height: 1px;
        }

        .features-section {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 40px auto;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 40px;
            padding: 60px 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
            font-family: sans-serif;
        }

        .section-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 50px;
        }

        .section-header h2 {
            font-size: 2rem;
            line-height: 100%;
            color: #222;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .grid-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr 1fr;
            gap: 30px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .column {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 30px;
        }

        .image-display {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 40px;
        }

        .circle-frame {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 400px;
            aspect-ratio: 780 / 740;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 5px solid #f2540d;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
            background: #eee;
        }

        .circle-frame>div {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
        }

        .circle-frame img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
        }

        .feature-card {
            display: block;
            background: white;
            padding: 25px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            border: 2px solid #eee;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
        }

        .feature-card h2 {
            margin: 0 0 10px 0;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: #222;
            font-weight: 550;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .feature-card p {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            color: #666;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .feature-card:hover {
            background-color: #fffcfa;
            transform: translateY(-8px);
            box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
        }

        input:focus-visible+label,
        input:focus-visible~.grid-container label {
            outline: none;
        }

        #feat1:checked~.grid-container .img1,
        #feat2:checked~.grid-container .img2,
        #feat3:checked~.grid-container .img3 {
            opacity: 1;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        #feat1:checked~.grid-container label[for="feat1"],
        #feat2:checked~.grid-container label[for="feat2"],
        #feat3:checked~.grid-container label[for="feat3"] {
            border-color: #f2540d;
            background-color: #fffcfa;
        }

        @media (max-width: 1060px) {
            .grid-container {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 40px;
            }

            .image-display {
                grid-row: 1;
            }

            .circle-frame {
                max-width: 320px;
            }

            .column {
                order: 2;
            }
        }
    </style>
